title: Girl First Holy Communion, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo Center Line MI
description: A black and white snapshot showing a young girl named Connie dressed in her white First Holy Communion gown and veil, standing with hands clasped in prayer outside a home near a trellis. The back is inscribed with Centerline (Center Line, Michigan) and Connie. First Communion portraits were cherished Catholic traditions in mid-century American suburban life.
